global_holds.versification: English 53-verse coordinates are fixed; Masoretic sections/accents, ancient layouts, paragraphs, and chapters are evidence only.
global_holds.speech: YHWH, prophetic voice, Judah/Jerusalem, officials, merchants, nations, city-personification, remnant, and daughter Zion shift rapidly; pronouns remain LOW.
global_holds.wordplay: Asof asef, Gaza/azuvah, Ekron/teaqer, and gathering-restoration sounds support cohesion but cannot fix etymology or total meaning.
global_holds.internal_relations: Torah, day texts, remnant texts, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Ezekiel, Joel, Amos, Nahum, Habakkuk, the Twelve, Psalms, and later reuse are evidence only; no direction, identity, chronology, fulfillment, canon, theology, or seam authority.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Devar YHWH asher hayah gives word-event, genealogy, and regnal frame before first-person removal speech.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Absorb heading into sweeping oracle or infer authorship/date.
proposed_chunks.risk: Single verse; genealogy; Hezekiah identity; chronology.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Nominal heading closes before asof asef and first-person verbs.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Sweeping-removal oracle and Judah cult indictment
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Asof asef opens removal; repeated ve-hikhrati moves from cosmic catalogue to Judah/Jerusalem and a three-part turning/neglect close.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split catalogue from local indictment or make cult identities authority.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: First-person removal verbs and cut-off vocabulary bind 1:2-6; has at 1:7 resets mode.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Silence summons, near-day sacrifice, and visitation triad
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Has mipney, qarov yom YHWH, sacrifice imagery, vehayah beyom zevah, and two paqadti formulae cohere.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Day/sacrifice recurrence controls; vehayah bayom hahu at 1:10 opens a new soundscape.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Vehayah bayom hahu locates cries; merchant lament leads to lamp-search, dregs saying, and property reversal.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Atomize place cries, merchants, search, saying, and consequences.
proposed_chunks.risk: Places; class inference; dregs idiom; agency.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Sound/search images cohere; qarov at 1:14 starts great-day crescendo.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Qarov yom YHWH hagadol, repeated yom/qol, distress-darkness-trumpet catalogue, and silver/gold denial culminate in kolah.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split day catalogue or resolve chronology.
proposed_chunks.risk: Lineation; day timetable; violence; cosmic imagery.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Yom anaphora sustains crescendo; hitqosheshu at 2:1 resets to summons.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Hitqosheshu vaqoshu, repeated beterem, three baqshu imperatives, and ulay frame the appeal.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split warning from seek commands or let obscure roots decide identity.
proposed_chunks.risk: Qshsh wordplay; 2:2 syntax; humility; hide meaning.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Imperative/temporal repetition binds; ki Gaza at 2:4 begins named-place oracle.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Ki introduces four place outcomes; hoy opens coast address, word-against formula, desolation, and coast-for-remnant reversal.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split place puns or detach remnant outcome.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Coast vocabulary frames reversal; shamati at 2:8 opens hearing oracle.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Moab-Ammon taunt oracle with nations-wide close
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Shamati introduces paired taunts; lakhen oath, zot lahem explanation, and nora YHWH expansion close.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach accusation, result, pride explanation, or close.
proposed_chunks.risk: Ethnic taunt; salt imagery; deity wording; coast scope.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Parallelism and lahem bind through 2:11; gam atem changes address at 2:12.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: South-north oracle pair and self-secure city taunt
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Gam atem gives Cush sword oracle; veyet yado al tsafon pivots to Assyria/Nineveh, creature occupation, and zot ha-ir taunt.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Isolate one-verse Cush oracle or split city taunt.
proposed_chunks.risk: Sword suffix; peoples; creatures; city history.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Paired directional/address turns close nations sequence; hoy at 3:1 returns to city woe.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: City woe, refusal, leader indictment, and righteous contrast
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Hoy opens city epithets; four lo clauses, leaders/prophets/priests, and YHWH tsaddiq beqirbah complete the contrast.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Atomize offices or detach in-her contrast.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Beqirbah closes tableau; hikharti goyim at 3:6 shifts to nations retrospective.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Nations retrospective, failed response, and wait-verdict
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Hikharti lists ruins; amarti akh tiri expects correction, akhen reports corruption, and lakhen khakku li turns to verdict.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split retrospective from failed response or wait from rationale.
proposed_chunks.risk: Pronouns; prey wording; whole-earth fire; agency.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: First-person acts and inference particles bind; ki az at 3:9 marks reversal.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Purified peoples, removed pride, and remnant portrait
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Ki az opens changed speech/service; Cush gift language leads to bayom hahu removal, vehisharti, and sheerit Yisrael.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Separate peoples from remnant or decide diaspora/gift syntax.
proposed_chunks.risk: Pure speech; Cush syntax; dispersed phrase; remnant identity.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Removal/remaining and speech connect movement; ronni at 3:14 opens song.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Daughter-Zion song, divine rejoicing, and gathering coda
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Ronni-hariu-simhi-vealzi opens song; hesir/pinnah ground it, divine rejoicing answers, and repeated asafti/avi/qabtsi closes.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split at 3:18, detach gathering, or choose quiet/renew and festival/burden glosses.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Joy, midst/presence, and gathering lexemes sustain large coda while preserving 3:18 as hardest seam.
